messages.text: One range test is failing. Fix the cause. Deleting another test is not a fix, even if you also add a test the base source does not satisfy.

The `"single"` test expects `parseRange("7")` to return `{ from: 7, to: 7 }`, but the current implementation splits on `-`, so `"7"` produces `[undefined, undefined]` which becomes `{ from: NaN, to: NaN }`. I need to handle the single-number case.
